rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for animated films, cartoons, and computer-generated animation.

example.english: I like watching Japanese animation best.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 jat6 bun2 dung6 waa6

rows.note: Use this for a person’s or group’s energy, vitality, or spiritedness.

example.english: This group of young people has a lot of animation.
example.traditional: 呢隊年輕人真係好有活力。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 nin4 hing1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the liveliness is especially shown in someone’s manner, performance, or delivery.

example.english: They spoke with great animation when introducing the product today.
example.traditional: 佢今日介紹產品嗰陣，講嘢講得好精神。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gaai3 siu6 caan2 ban2 go2 zan6 gong2 je5 gong2 dak1 hou2 zing1 san4
